description: This plot illustrates the Loss Ratio (%) as a function of TFLOPs for five different model configurations: Vanilla, SepLLM (n=64), SepLLM (n=128), SepLLM (n=64, H), and SepLLM (n=64, H/T). The x-axis is labeled "TFLOPs" and displays a custom non-linear scale with discrete, evenly spaced tick marks at specific values: 1e7, 2e7, 5e7, 1e8, 2e8, 3e8, 4e8, 5e8, 6e8, 7e8, 8e8, and 9e8. The y-axis is labeled "Loss Ratio (%)" and uses a linear scale ranging from 94 to 100, with tick marks at regular intervals of 1 unit. The "Vanilla" configuration is represented by a solid purple line with upward-pointing triangle markers; it remains perfectly steady at a value of 100 across the entire x-axis from 1e7 to 9e8. The "SepLLM (n=64)" configuration is shown as a solid orange line with vertical line markers. It begins at approximately 98.3 at 1e7, rises to a peak of roughly 100.4 at 4e8, and then settles near 100 by 9e8. The "SepLLM (n=128)" configuration is depicted by a solid dark blue line with 'x' markers. It starts at about 97.0 at 1e7, increases to approximately 99.8 by 2e8, and remains relatively stable, ending at roughly 99.8 at 9e8. The "SepLLM (n=64, H)" configuration is indicated by a solid green line with diamond markers. It starts at approximately 97.5 at 1e7, climbs to a peak of about 100.2 at 6e8, and concludes at roughly 99.9 at 9e8. Finally, the "SepLLM (n=64, H/T)" configuration is represented by a solid red line with circle markers. It begins at the lowest point of 94.0 at 1e7, rises sharply to 97.2 at 5e7, reaches a peak of approximately 99.1 at 4e8, dips to about 98.4 at 5e8, and ends at approximately 98.7 at 9e8.
